title: MARS: Multi-hop Adaptive Retrieval and SPARQL Generation for KGQA
abstract: arXiv:2607.14561v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning performance, but their tendency to hallucinate limits their reliability in knowledge-intensive tasks requiring up-to-date and grounded information. Combining knowledge graphs (KGs) with LLMs facilitates the use of explicit symbolic knowledge that can be continuously updated without costly fine-tuning, while benefiting from rapidly advancing LLM reasoning. We propose MARS, a scalable knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) approach that requires no model fine-tuning. Rather than relying on open-ended agentic exploration, MARS performs a structured retrieval procedure that links question entities to the KG and iteratively retrieves relevant next-hop information. At each step, MARS decides whether to continue graph traversal or to generate the final SPARQL query, allowing the model to adapt the retrieval depth to the question while keeping the overall pipeline more predic

translated_title: MARS：面向知识图谱问答的多跳自适应检索与SPARQL生成
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已展现出强大的推理能力，但其产生幻觉的倾向限制了它们在需要最新且有依据信息的知识密集型任务中的可靠性。将知识图谱（KGs）与大型语言模型相结合，有助于利用无需昂贵微调即可持续更新的显式符号知识，同时受益于快速发展的LLM推理能力。我们提出了MARS，一种无需模型微调的可扩展知识图谱问答（KGQA）方法。MARS不依赖于开放式的智能体探索，而是执行一种结构化的检索过程，将问题实体链接到知识图谱，并迭代检索相关的下一跳信息。在每个步骤中，MARS决定是继续图遍历还是生成最终的SPARQL查询，使模型能够根据问题自适应调整检索深度，同时保持整个流程更加可预测。
tldr: MARS提出了一种无需微调的知识图谱问答方法，通过结构化的多跳自适应检索过程，在每一步决定继续图遍历还是生成最终SPARQL查询，从而根据问题自适应调整检索深度。
en_tdlr: MARS is a fine-tuning-free KGQA approach that performs structured multi-hop adaptive retrieval, deciding at each step whether to continue graph traversal or generate the final SPARQL query to adapt retrieval depth to the question.
